note: Explicit facts the generator (tools/s4/catalog_build.py) cannot read from a function body. Every cmd_/q_ function whose tier is not visible as bnx.require(a, N) must be listed here, otherwise the generator fails (no silent default).

descriptions.q_ai_connections: The caller's AI connections: client, host profile, scopes, consented account-currencies, last token issue, revocation state (PWA only)
descriptions.q_audit_trail: Audit chain events (command, subject, member, channel, version, host provenance); Owner and admins see the household, others their own
descriptions.q_ledger_accounts: Ledger accounts the caller may book against (visible account-currencies with can_post) and active income and expense categories (PWA Quick Entry)
descriptions.q_health: Instance health without identity values; answers while a binding check fails
descriptions.q_whoami: The calling member, channel, connection and scopes
descriptions.q_config_status: Active configuration version, digest, flags, pending versions, identity and schema head
descriptions.q_balances: Balances per account-currency at a date and ledger version (R1 R-BAL)
descriptions.q_f1_balances: F1 balances with statement column, reporting currency and envelope
descriptions.q_f2_transactions: F2 transactions with masked lines and calendar flows
descriptions.q_f3_income_expense: F3 income and expense by flow class
descriptions.q_f5_networth: F5 net worth (book value) with R28 elimination
descriptions.q_f6_cards: F6 cards: owed balance, statements, annual-fee progress
descriptions.q_cashflow_statement: R09 cash flow by flow class (cash basis)
descriptions.q_backup_status: Backup runs, drills, keys, evidence verification and the O-8 anchor precondition
descriptions.q_cost_status: Usage, ceilings, capacity state and admissions of a billing month
descriptions.cmd_create_account: Create an account with its account-currencies
descriptions.q_onboarding_jobs: Onboarding jobs the caller may see, newest first: kind, title, start policy and state (PWA only)
descriptions.cmd_set_mail_route: Owner: file a mailbox's verified statement mail into a folder, by institution or as the coverage-home catch-all, from a date (append-only)
descriptions.q_mail_routes: Owner: the mail folder routes of every mailbox, newest first (no address)

note_names: AIH V1.2 §2.2 tool names where bnx.function_scope carries none; every other entry is named from function_scope.note or pwa.<rest name>
note_ui_cards: AIH-4 (UA V1.2 §12.3; AIH §8): MCP tools whose result the host renders with the one MCP App resource ui://balnexa/cards/v1, by card profile. Display only: the card opens the sealed PWA link and never calls a tool (in-card approval off, OD-40).

cmd_draft_create_transaction.description: Propose one transaction on an account the connection may see. Nothing is posted: the household Owner reviews and approves the draft in Balnexa.

account_currency_id.description: The account-currency the money moves on (from fin.balances.as_of)

amount.description: Signed amount on the account: negative = money out, positive = money in

counter_ledger_account_id.description: The category or other ledger account on the other side (from fin.ledger.accounts); use with amount

amount.description: Signed amount on the account: negative = money out, positive = money in

lines.description: Full balanced lines instead of amount + counter_ledger_account_id

description.description: Short description; no account, card or government ID numbers

supersedes_plan_id.description: An earlier draft this one replaces

cmd_draft_create_transfer.description: Propose a transfer between two of the household's account-currencies. Nothing is posted until the Owner approves.

description.description: Short description; no account, card or government ID numbers

cmd_draft_revise.description: Replace the proposed transaction of an open draft (a new version; the Owner approves exactly the version shown).

item.description: The proposed transaction (same fields as fin.draft.create_transaction)

description.description: Short description; no account, card or government ID numbers

amount.description: Signed amount on the account: negative = money out, positive = money in
Signed amount on the account: negative = money out, positive = money in

cmd_draft_validate.description: Re-run the checks of a draft and return its findings; changes nothing.

cmd_draft_withdraw.description: Withdraw a draft this connection created; it can no longer be approved.

q_draft_get_for_confirmation.description: The current version of a draft as the Owner will see it, with the link where the Owner confirms it.

q_balances.description: Balances of the account-currencies the connection may see, as of a date.

note_schemas: 2.8 curated tool schemas (L-CORE7-2, L-AIH-7): hand-written input schemas and descriptions for the tools AI hosts use most. The generator refuses a curated schema that omits a key the function reads, or adds one it does not read; provenance becomes 'curated'.
